bullets: Added a tracking code to login links in sponsored tasks so advertisers can identify your session.
Blocked sponsored links that are missing a valid tracking code to prevent broken connections.
Locked down CLI configuration and data files so only you can read them on shared computers.
Cleaned up finished background tasks from the process list to stop false alerts on Mac and Linux.
Removed the experimental background worker feature from the coding assistant.
Grouped related tasks into single batches for the fast model to prevent one-step-at-a-time drift.
Treated network glitches like lost Wi-Fi as temporary errors so the assistant can retry instead of failing.
Extended the login wait time to match your approval code's life so sign-up and verification do not time out.
Updated documentation to describe model prices as multipliers in the model picker.
Added a step prompt for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to keep it from drifting back to single tool calls.
Increased CLI login polling timeout to match the auth code lifetime.
Added a desktop workspace option that removes the task checklist and limits questions.
Redacted backend access keys from error logs to prevent sensitive credentials from leaking into records.
Added a new internal check to identify sponsor pre-checks that cannot be answered from current project files.
Removed unmetered and session language from model documentation in English and Chinese.
Prevented ad links with placeholder tracking codes from being shown or opened in the terminal app.
Allowed cloud skills to have an optional enabled switch without breaking older skill libraries.
Removed the async subagent harness and added a batch prompt section to the base3 agent.
Added a tier-aware pricing overlay and a sessions-left label to the pricing system.
